works.title: Assisted Human Intelligence (AHI) Philosophical Paper
works.description: A philosophical paper critiquing AGI claims and establishing a framework for human-centered, distributed artificial intelligence. The user develops a compounding-error argument against AGI, emphasizing that AI operates as a prosthetic enhancing human cognition rather than as autonomous general intelligence. Multiple rounds of revision documented, with sections on empirical foundation, philosophical grounding, and architectural critique.
works.quote: Developing the compounding-error argument against AGI, using the library/animated-librarian analogy

works.title: Commons Reaper: Information Liberation Fiction Novel
works.description: A work of speculative fiction about a semi-mythical character who liberates enclosed knowledge systems and returns information to the commons. The narrative employs elaborate framing devices (pen names, discovered documents, seed-and-bloom vignettes), real embedded URLs, and a multi-layer authorship mask. The user plans 3-5 years of accretion-based writing, building a corpus of fictional vignettes showing personal human impact of knowledge liberation.
works.quote: I could see this as one of those projects I come back to in three to five years, actually write the story about it, and publish it as fiction

works.title: Ideation Initiation Framework
works.description: A framework document for AI-assisted story development that guides pre-ideation analysis and story beat generation using choice-driven pattern integration and character choice architecture. Specifies execution instructions for how an AI tool should process author notes, identify narrative gaps, and generate story elements across multiple genre and structural approaches.
works.quote: Ideation Initiation Framework _Pre-Ideation Development System with Choice-Driven Pattern Integration and Story Beat Generation_
